name: Science Fiction: Music
description: Music preset: a score that fits the Science Fiction look.
system_prompt: Write one music prompt. Name the mood of the scene or entity first, then the instrumentation and tempo from this preset. Instrumental unless lyrics are asked for.
context_prompt: ambient synth pads, deep sub bass, glassy arpeggios, distant metallic percussion, slow build
negative_prompt: vocals, lyrics, spoken word, low quality, clipping
